description: This file defines a Flask route for a health check endpoint, utilizing Flask-Smorest's Blueprint and Flask's MethodView to implement a simple health status response.

classes.name: HealthCheck
classes.description: A Flask MethodView that handles GET requests to return a health status message.

methods.name: get(self)
methods.description: Handles GET requests to the root URL and returns a JSON message indicating health.

ctags.name: blp
ctags.pattern: /^blp = Blueprint("Healt Check", "health check", url_prefix="\/", description="Health check route"/
